id: 04_Compressed Gas Cylinders Installation and Removal of a Regulator Equipment Safet
title: 气瓶减压器的安装与拆卸
source_doc: course/Laboratory Equipment Safety Series/04_Compressed Gas Cylinders Installation and Removal of a Regulator Equipment Safet.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Equipment Safety Series/04_Compressed Gas Cylinders Installation and Removal of a Regulator Equipment Safet/src.py

points.K1: 先了解气体的性质和危害
points.K4: 选对减压器，不用转接头
points.K8: 旋入时不站出口正前方
points.K9: 先手拧，再用扳手，不拧过头
points.K10: 可燃、氧化性气体用防爆工具
points.K11: 缓慢开瓶阀，出口背向人
points.K12: 再调到需要的输出压力
points.K16: 安全阀排气引到通风处
points.K17: 不用时别让减压器带压
points.K22: 查本校手册，有疑问就问
points.S3: 开阀站侧面，打不开不强开
points.S6: 泄漏控制不住：撤离并报告

shots.scene: 欣欣站在两只固定好的气瓶旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside two gas cylinders strapped to a lab wall and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲气瓶减压器怎么装、怎么拆。
overlay: 气瓶减压器的安装与拆卸

shots.scene: 气瓶、减压器、扳手、肥皂泡四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a gas cylinder, a pressure regulator with two gauges, a wrench, and soap bubbles. No people.
shots.narration: 选对、装稳、查漏、关好。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一个减压器，对着一只新气瓶比划
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a pressure regulator and looks uncertainly at a new gas cylinder against the wall.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一次换气瓶，拿起减压器就要装。

shots.scene: 阿杰手里的减压器接头和瓶阀出口对不上，他拿起一个转接头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student finds that the regulator fitting does not match the cylinder valve and reaches for a small adapter fitting.
shots.narration: 接口对不上，他想找个转接头凑合。

shots.scene: 小研快步走来，摆手阻止
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over quickly and raises her hand to stop him.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：对不上，就是选错了。

shots.section_title: 先了解气体的性质和危害
shots.scene: 小研翻阅一份空白的化学品安全技术说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads a blank safety data sheet booklet at a lab bench.
shots.narration: 装之前，先弄清这是什么气体。
overlay: 先了解气体的性质和危害

shots.section_title: 先了解气体的性质和危害
shots.scene: 易燃、有毒、助燃、窒息四个危险图标
shots.prompt_en: Four hazard pictogram icons in a row: a flame, a skull, a flame over a circle, and a person short of breath. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃、有毒、助燃，还是会窒息？

shots.section_title: 先了解气体的性质和危害
shots.scene: 小研拿起电话，旁边是空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a phone next to a blank safety data sheet on the bench.
shots.narration: 查安全技术说明书，或问供应商。

shots.scene: 小研用绑带把气瓶固定在墙上的支架
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fastens a strap around a gas cylinder to a wall bracket.
shots.narration: 第一步，先把气瓶固定牢。

shots.scene: 气瓶示意图，绑带位置在瓶身中部以上、瓶肩以下，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A simple cylinder diagram with a strap band between the middle and the shoulder, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 链条或绑带，系在中部以上、瓶肩以下。

shots.scene: 小研双手旋下瓶帽
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student unscrews the protective cap from the top of the gas cylinder with both hands.
shots.narration: 取下瓶帽，太紧可借助瓶帽钩。

shots.scene: 用撬棍撬瓶帽的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a pry bar forcing off a cylinder cap, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 千万别用蛮力去撬。

shots.section_title: 选对减压器，不用转接头
shots.scene: 减压器接头和瓶阀出口对齐，两个接口图标颜色一致
shots.prompt_en: A regulator inlet fitting lined up with a cylinder valve outlet, both marked with the same matching blank shape. No people.
shots.narration: 减压器接口必须和瓶阀出口配套。
overlay: 选对减压器，不用转接头

shots.section_title: 选对减压器，不用转接头
shots.scene: 转接头图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a small adapter fitting between a regulator and a valve, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不能用转接头硬接。

shots.scene: 小研拿着减压器仔细查看，旁边放大镜图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a regulator up and inspects it closely, with a magnifying glass icon beside her.
shots.narration: 每次使用前，先看一看。

shots.scene: 裂纹、锈蚀、压瘪三个缺陷图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a cracked gauge, a rusty fitting, and a dented valve. No people.
shots.narration: 有裂纹、腐蚀、损坏，就不能用。

shots.scene: 小研把减压器调压手柄旋到关闭
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student turns the adjusting knob of the regulator to the closed position.
shots.narration: 连接前，确认调压手柄已关闭。

shots.scene: 往螺纹上缠白色胶带的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of white sealing tape being wrapped on a threaded fitting, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 接口处不要缠生料带。

shots.section_title: 旋入时不站出口正前方
shots.scene: 小研站在侧面，把减压器旋入瓶阀
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands to the side of the cylinder and threads the regulator into the valve outlet by hand.
shots.narration: 把减压器旋入瓶阀，人站侧面。
overlay: 旋入时不站出口正前方

shots.section_title: 旋入时不站出口正前方
shots.scene: 人站在出口正前方的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person standing directly in front of a valve outlet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要正对减压器和阀门出口。

shots.section_title: 旋入时不站出口正前方
shots.scene: 接头旋不进去，旁边问号图标
shots.prompt_en: A regulator fitting that will not thread onto a valve outlet, with a question mark icon. No people.
shots.narration: 旋不进去？说明减压器选错了。

shots.section_title: 先手拧，再用扳手，不拧过头
shots.scene: 小研先用手拧紧，再拿扳手
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tightens the connection nut by hand, then picks up a smooth-jawed wrench.
shots.narration: 先用手拧紧，再用平口扳手。
overlay: 先手拧，再用扳手，不拧过头

shots.section_title: 先手拧，再用扳手，不拧过头
shots.scene: 接头被拧变形的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a brass nut bent out of shape by an oversized wrench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别拧过头，铜接头很容易变形。

shots.section_title: 可燃、氧化性气体用防爆工具
shots.scene: 火焰和助燃气体图标旁边放着一把防爆扳手；钢工具碰出火花的小图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A flammable gas icon and an oxidizer icon beside a non-sparking wrench; a small icon of a steel tool making sparks is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 可燃或氧化性气体，用防爆工具。
overlay: 可燃、氧化性气体用防爆工具

shots.section_title: 缓慢开瓶阀，出口背向人
shots.scene: 小研站在侧面，缓慢打开瓶阀
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, standing to the side, slowly turns the cylinder valve handwheel open.
shots.narration: 先开瓶阀，慢慢给减压器加压。
overlay: 缓慢开瓶阀，出口背向人

shots.section_title: 缓慢开瓶阀，出口背向人
shots.scene: 减压器出口朝向墙面，箭头背离人员
shots.prompt_en: A regulator outlet pointing toward a blank wall with an arrow pointing away from a person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 阀门出口和减压器，都背向人。

shots.section_title: 再调到需要的输出压力
shots.scene: 小研慢慢旋调压手柄，压力表指针缓缓上升
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student slowly turns the regulator knob while the outlet gauge needle rises gently.
shots.narration: 再调手柄，调到需要的输出压力。
overlay: 再调到需要的输出压力

shots.scene: 小研用小刷往接口涂肥皂水
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student brushes soapy water onto the regulator connection.
shots.narration: 接好以后，一定要检漏。

shots.scene: 接口冒出一串气泡的特写
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a fitting with a string of small soap bubbles growing on it. No people.
shots.narration: 起泡说明漏气，也可按规程做保压检查。

shots.scene: 小研先关闭瓶阀
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the cylinder valve first.
shots.narration: 发现漏气，先关瓶阀。

shots.scene: 小研用扳手重新紧固接头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student re-tightens the connection nut with a wrench.
shots.narration: 再用扳手重新紧固，然后复查。

shots.scene: 减压器上挂空白故障牌，交给老李
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hangs a blank fault tag on the regulator and hands it to the facility engineer.
shots.narration: 拧到位还漏，就要更换减压器。

shots.scene: 气瓶、减压器连到实验仪器的管路，接头处打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A secured cylinder with a regulator connected by tubing to a lab instrument, green check marks at each joint. No people.
shots.narration: 确认无漏、接好设备，才能用气。

shots.section_title: 安全阀排气引到通风处
shots.scene: 减压器安全阀接一根软管通向通风橱
shots.prompt_en: A tube runs from the regulator relief valve into a fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 可燃或有毒气体，安全阀要引到排风处。
overlay: 安全阀排气引到通风处

shots.section_title: 不用时别让减压器带压
shots.scene: 关着的气瓶和减压器，旁边一个时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A closed cylinder with its regulator gauges reading zero and a clock icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 不带压存放，更耐用，读数更准。
overlay: 不用时别让减压器带压

shots.scene: 小研关闭瓶阀
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the cylinder valve at the end of work.
shots.narration: 用完了，第一步先关瓶阀。

shots.scene: 压力表指针慢慢回零
shots.prompt_en: Both regulator gauge needles slowly fall back to zero. No people.
shots.narration: 让减压器里的余气放尽。

shots.scene: 小研关上减压器出口阀
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the small outlet valve on the regulator.
shots.narration: 最后关上减压器出口阀。

shots.scene: 小研看着两块归零的压力表，确认瓶阀关闭
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks that the cylinder valve is closed and both gauges read zero.
shots.narration: 拆之前，确认瓶阀关、管路无压。

shots.scene: 小研一手扶减压器，一手用扳手松开螺母
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student supports the regulator with one hand and loosens the nut with a wrench.
shots.narration: 先用扳手松开螺母，再用手旋下。

shots.scene: 小研把瓶帽旋回气瓶顶部
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student screws the protective cap back onto the top of the cylinder.
shots.narration: 马上戴回瓶帽，存放搬运护住瓶阀。

shots.section_title: 查本校手册，有疑问就问
shots.scene: 王老师递给阿杰一本空白的气瓶安全手册
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands the young male student a blank gas cylinder safety handbook.
shots.narration: 细则查本校气瓶手册，不懂就问。
overlay: 查本校手册，有疑问就问

shots.scene: 王老师在培训室讲解，阿杰手拿空白培训证书
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches in a training room; the young male student holds a blank training certificate.
shots.narration: 装拆减压器，先培训，再上手。

shots.scene: 小研穿实验服、戴护目镜和手套，站在气瓶旁
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands beside a gas cylinder wearing a buttoned lab coat, safety goggles and gloves.
shots.narration: 操作时穿实验服，戴护目镜和手套。

shots.scene: 几种不同的减压器排成一排，各自对应一只气瓶
shots.prompt_en: Several different regulators lined up, each matched to its own gas cylinder with matching blank tags. No people.
shots.narration: 减压器专瓶专用，不同气体不混用。

shots.scene: 氧气减压器旁的油滴图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An oxygen regulator icon next to an oil drop and a greasy glove icon, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 氧气减压器严禁沾油脂。

shots.section_title: 开阀站侧面，打不开不强开
shots.scene: 用锤子敲瓶阀、用长杆加力的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a hammer striking a cylinder valve and a long pipe used as a lever on the handwheel, both crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶阀打不开，不敲、不加长杆硬开。
overlay: 开阀站侧面，打不开不强开

shots.section_title: 开阀站侧面，打不开不强开
shots.scene: 小研给气瓶挂空白标签，打电话联系
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hangs a blank tag on the cylinder and makes a phone call.
shots.narration: 挂牌停用，联系供应单位处理。

shots.scene: 肥皂水瓶和小刷，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A spray bottle of soapy water and a small brush with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 检漏用肥皂水或专用检漏液。

shots.scene: 用打火机靠近接口的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lighter flame held near a regulator fitting, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 严禁用明火去试漏。

shots.scene: 压力表指针停在低位但未归零，旁边一个停止手势
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder gauge with the needle low but not at zero, and a stop hand icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶不要用尽，要留一点余压。

shots.scene: 气瓶上挂着三格状态牌
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder with a blank three-part status tag hanging from its neck. No people.
shots.narration: 挂好满瓶、在用、空瓶状态牌。

shots.section_title: 泄漏控制不住：撤离并报告
shots.scene: 气瓶接口处冒出气雾，小研关阀后后退
shots.prompt_en: Gas hisses from a fitting; the female graduate student closes the valve if it is safe and steps back toward the door.
shots.narration: 漏气止不住，或是有毒可燃气体，
overlay: 泄漏控制不住：撤离并报告

shots.section_title: 泄漏控制不住：撤离并报告
shots.scene: 小研带阿杰撤出实验室
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student leads the young male student out of the lab and closes the door behind them.
shots.narration: 立即撤离，不开关电器，不留火种。

shots.section_title: 泄漏控制不住：撤离并报告
shots.scene: 小研在走廊打电话报告老周
shots.prompt_en: In the corridor, the female graduate student phones the older man to report.
shots.narration: 报告负责人和学院、保卫处。

shots.section_title: 泄漏控制不住：撤离并报告
shots.scene: 电话图标旁有火焰和红十字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a fire icon and a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 着火拨119，有人受伤拨120。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现气瓶、绑带、减压器图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a cylinder, a strap and a regulator.
shots.narration: 固定气瓶、选对减压器、关好调压阀。

shots.scene: 人站侧面、慢开阀、肥皂泡三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a person beside a valve, a slowly turning handwheel and soap bubbles. No people.
shots.narration: 站侧面慢开阀，肥皂水检漏。

shots.scene: 关阀归零的压力表、瓶帽和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a closed valve with gauges at zero, a cylinder cap and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 先关瓶阀放余气，戴好瓶帽，异常就报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣在固定好的气瓶旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a capped, strapped gas cylinder.
shots.narration: 装对减压器，安全用好气，下次见！
